session.hypothesis: If we keep strong pre-lock samples alive through one weak frame, near-hit detections should convert into a committed lock instead of resetting the buffer before pose acceptance.
session.operatorNote: Start 30 to 60 cm away, keep the full poster in frame, move in slowly until DETECTED, then hold almost perfectly still for 3 full seconds before testing one brief loss and reacquire.
session.successCriteria: Reach TRACKING within 5 seconds, show at least 2 stable pre-lock frames before commit, and complete one clean reacquire without repeated DETECTED-only churn.
